criteria.requirement: Add treelib.navigation.resolve_path, lowest_common_ancestor and path_between. Use actual current-tree parent/successor relationships, never tag equality as identity. resolve_path consumes literal string segments (not an implicitly split string), absolute paths include root tag; explicit start provides relative paths. Zero matches is None/[], ambiguity raises by default or returns all nodes in current sibling order. Slash-containing tags and duplicate tags remain usable. path_between includes both endpoints in source-to-target order; LCA is nearest common ancestor, same-node/shared-view/missing-ID and corrupted parent chains are explicit. Iterative parent walks avoid recursion limits; this is tree navigation, not an arbitrary graph shortest-path engine.
